claims.title: Quantitative exclusion of bounded-power arithmetic translation algebras
claims.ledger_status: PROJECT ANALYTIC PROOF + INDEPENDENT INTERNAL REVIEW + PORTABLE EXACT FINITE CONTROLS; NO ANALYTIC FORMALIZATION
claims.boundary: Unchanged odd-dimensional U_N and literal fixed tau=10^-80. For every odd d>=3 dividing N, compression of Ad(U_N) to the d^2-1 nonzero d-grid Weyl modes is <=min(1,C_tau(d^262/N)^(1/129)), with C_tau independent of N,d and labels. Every fixed delta<1/262 gives decay for d<=N^delta; d<=N^(1/524) gives N^(-1/258). Uniform residual tends to sqrt(2); fixed d is a corollary. Projection interpretation requires a nonzero centered part and membership in the indicated algebra. No exponent optimality, endpoint decay, unrestricted growing divisor, arbitrary projector/full commutant classification, practical startup, shrinking-tau uniformity or microscopic BGS claim.

dependency_note: FM-001 supplies the exact model; FM-016 supplies the overlap architecture and FM-018 the quantitative actual-kick estimate, whose needed derivations are reconstructed in the canonical proof. Their channel mixing/gap statements are not imported.
